fusions.name: Thorn Seed
fusions.desc: Spits a thorned seed that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Briar Stand
fusions.desc: Plants the tines and raises briars that deal 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Rooted Tine
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Deep Taproot
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.6 health a second, permanently.
